'''Imperial recruiters''' was a [[Assignment/Legends|type]] of loyal [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who recruited individuals into the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] or [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==History==
[[File:Imperialrecruitposter.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An Imperial recruitment poster]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Recruitment officer/Legends|recruitment officers]] were stationed in multiple cities, bases and camps on multiple worlds throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

Aside from their recruitment duties, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] recruiters would also sell certain supplies and equipment to soldiers, depending on their rank.<ref name="SWG:C3">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Chapter 3: Smugglers and Scoundrels}}</ref> Imperial recruiters would also sort and file paperwork whenever Imperial military personnel went on leave.<ref name="SWG" />

[[Limna Renence]] served as recruiting officer in the [[Imperial Navy Recruitment|recruitment office]] of the Imperial Navy.<ref name="SWG:IDN">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|Imperial Daily News}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Imperial Recruiters are [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Characters]] (NPCs) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', which players can speak to in order to join the Empire.<ref name="SWG" /> In the game, they sell a number of items depending on the rank of the player.<ref name="SWG:C3" /> They also change the player's faction status, and inform players on who has planetary control.<ref name="SWG" />
